text:
marta: Quick heads-up — scheduling a drip release for the route-split rollout tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Plan: seed a small geo bucket in NA-west, then expand to NA-east. Need owners for smoke, rollback, and cohort mapping.

josh: I can take smoke checks. Will run the smoke checklist and keep an eye on latency / error-rate dashboards. Ping me at deploy time. :+1:

priya: I can be rollback lead. I'll prepare the rollback playbook and standby during the window. Please add the backout command to the runbook.

marta: thanks. high-level ramp:
```
seed: 0.5% NA-west (15m)
ramp1: 1% (30m)
ramp2: 5% (30m)
hold: manual gate at 5% for sign-off (15m)
then progressive to 100% if metrics OK (target 2h total)
```

alex: I'll own cohort mapping and geo buckets. Confirming NA-west includes us-west1 and us-west2, NA-east includes us-east1. I'll attach the selector list to the release doc.

josh: Quick Q — are we serving the quantized-v2 model in the canary or the float baseline? Latency/cost behavior will differ.

marta: We'll start with quantized-v2 for the canary to validate cost/latency tradeoffs; fallback to float if we hit correctness regressions. Add fallback policy to the rollout config.

priya: Rollback command for quick execution (will pre-authorize in ops):
```bash
rwdctl rollout rollback --release route-split-20260401 --to stable --reason "canary-failure"
```

deploy-bot: scheduled by marta for 2026-04-01T17:00:00Z — link: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/route-split-20260401 

marta: I've added the owners to the release doc and wired the dashboards. Monitoring thresholds: errors > 1.5x baseline or p99 latency +150ms -> automatic pause and notify. Also manual stop at 5% gate.

josh: I'll set up the smoke checklist items: sample prompts, end-to-end latencies, error counts, and token-cost checks. Will post a snapshot 10m before start.

priya: I'll be on rotation for rollback for the first hour. If anything triggers the auto-pause, I'll coordinate the rollback within the 15m RTO window.

marta: perfect. final ask — can everyone acknowledge readiness in this thread and include any blockers?

alex: ack, no blockers. updating selector file now.

josh: ack, smoke checklist prepared.

priya: ack, rollback playbook ready.

marta: thanks team. I'll post the final release doc and add the manual gate to the console. :rocket:
